items.title: Gingerbread Dough with a Star Cutter
items.alt: Rolled brown gingerbread dough with a clean star-shaped opening and a metal star cutter beside it.
items.description: A light dusting of flour stays within the irregular dough shape around the empty cutout.

items.title: Gingerbread Cookie Wreath
items.alt: Round wreath of iced star, heart and house cookies with holly leaves, red berries and a large sage green bow.
items.description: The cookies overlap around an open center, with long ribbon tails hanging beneath the top bow.

items.title: Sweet Holidays Gingerbread Lettering
items.alt: Smiling gingerbread letters spelling Sweet Holidays in two rows, edged with white icing and dotted with red and green candy.
items.description: Tiny cookie arms and feet animate the letters, with a small smiling star at the end of the top row.

items.title: Gingerbread Flying a Star Kite Outline
items.alt: Black-and-white gingerbread character in a striped cap flying a star-shaped kite with a bow-tailed string.
items.description: Three heart buttons and scalloped icing cuffs decorate the one-legged skipping pose.

items.title: Gingerbread Castle Pop-Up Book Outline
items.alt: Black-and-white open book with a two-towered gingerbread castle rising from its pages.
items.description: Striped candy columns, heart decorations and iced battlements frame the arched castle door.

items.title: Gingerbread Riding a Bicycle Outline
items.alt: Black-and-white gingerbread character in a pom-pom cap and dotted vest riding a small bicycle.
items.description: Both cookie hands meet the handlebars, with bent legs positioned over the pedals between the full wheels.
